limitations: A passing pilot permits only a separately frozen full-acquisition protocol and does not authorize any additional archive automatically.
Checksum and ZIP integrity do not establish point-in-time contract metadata, fee schedules, executable spread, slippage, or liquidity.
No pilot result creates candidate, backtest, paper, sandbox, micro-live, live, or capital eligibility.
Structural inspection validates files, schemas, timestamps, and finite values but calculates no return, signal, trade, or outcome.
The pilot covers only three deterministic symbols and three deterministic months; it is a schema/resource sample, not a complete derivatives dataset.
The pilot does not establish funding settlement, paired execution, collateral, margin, liquidation, ADL, or reconciliation correctness.
